whatIsThis.docTypeLabel: Request for documents: Canada Child Benefit review

explanation.en: The CRA is reviewing your Canada Child Benefit and wants proof that you and your children live in Canada, for example a lease or a letter from a school or daycare. Send the documents through CRA's official Submit Documents service by October 14, 2026.

items.reason: CRA is an agency we track. Anyone can print an agency name, so this alone proves little.
Matches CRA's published child and family benefits phone line.
canada.ca is an official Government of Canada domain.
This is a new reference number. There's no earlier case to compare it with yet.

officialContact.label: CRA child and family benefits enquiries

printed.sourceText: Please send the documents by October 14, 2026.

deadline.note: CRA set this deadline in the letter. It isn't a legal (statutory) deadline, but missing it can pause or change your benefit.

stages.label: CRA reviews them
stages.expectNext: A letter with the result, or a request for more information. CRA doesn't guarantee a timeline.

steps: Gather the documents in the checklist.
Open CRA's Submit documents online service (link above). Don't use links sent by email or text.
Enter the reference number printed on your letter when asked.
Save the confirmation number here so Enveloppe can track your case.
